Enable language detection and inspect the ISO 639-3 code returned with the document.

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	xberg "github.com/xberg-io/xberg/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	input := xberg.ExtractInput{
		Kind:     ptr(xberg.ExtractInputKindURI),
		URI:      ptr(`https://example.com/text/report.txt`),
		MimeType: ptr(`text/plain`),
	}
	config := xberg.ExtractionConfig{
		LanguageDetection: &xberg.LanguageDetectionConfig{
		Enabled:        ptr(true),
		MinConfidence:  ptr(float64(0.5)),
		DetectMultiple: false,
	},
	}
	result, err := xberg.Extract(input, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Results[0].DetectedLanguages)
}
```
